evidence.title: GitHub - aidenybai/react-scan: Scan and fix React performance issues

name: React Scan
summary: Drop-in tool that detects and highlights the React components whose renders cause performance problems.
description: React Scan automatically detects performance issues in a React app and highlights the exact components to optimize, with no code changes. It installs through a script tag, an npm package or a browser extension, its init command detects the framework and wires up the project, and it exposes scan(), useScan(), setOptions(), getOptions() and onRender() plus an always-available on-page toolbar. MIT licensed; the site now also points to React Doctor for agent-facing checks.
contains: highlights components that render and cause performance issues
available via script tag, npm install and browser extension
init command detects the framework and sets up the project
APIs: scan(), useScan(), setOptions(), getOptions(), onRender()
setup guides for Next.js App/Pages Router, Vite and Remix
